title: Port the compounding-complete door natively so a feature can reach its terminal phase again
action: Since the Rust cutover, state set --phase compounding-complete returns the Node delegate marker at set_gate.rs:179 and :213, so no lane or feature can EVER close - the router reports unsupported_argument_shape. Port the door: keep check_phase_transition (phase must be compounding; fresh last_compounding_run, waivable by --waive-compounding) as the freshness half, then add the scribing-debt half chain-integrity D2 specifies - refuse when drivers::close::scribing_debt(root, feature) > 0, naming every capped behavior_change cell still owing its spec sync. Two escapes, both loud: the --waive-scribing-debt flag (already a known flag at set_gate.rs:118-131 but consumed nowhere), or an already-logged capture-deferral decision naming the feature (drivers::close::has_capture_deferral_decision). Each waiver logs a decision naming the feature and every waived cell, matching the wording already in .bee/decisions.jsonl. Then perform the write instead of delegating - both Err2::Ex returns go. Works for the lane branch and the default record alike.

truths: a clean compounding record reaches compounding-complete and the phase is written
debt>0 refuses and names every unscribed cell
--waive-scribing-debt passes and logs a decision naming the cells
a logged capture-deferral decision passes without the flag
the freshness half still refuses and --waive-compounding still lifts it
the lane branch and the default record behave the same
